
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/qiuzhendezhen/p/19197533" title="发布于 2025-11-06 19:06">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">kamailio+rtpengine对sdp的处理</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="lake-content">
<p><img alt="头图-80" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2500940/202511/2500940-20251106190544021-544806762.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1 id="RdeO4"><span class="ne-text">概述</span></h1>
<p id="u59e9bc5f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">使用kamailio+rtpengine的过程中，默认会使用rtpengine处理sdp信息，同时又需要对sdp信息定制，就需要对cfg配置流程中做特殊处理才能实现。</span></p>
<h1 id="tZals"><span class="ne-text">环境</span></h1>
<p id="u008440b8" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">CentOS 7.9</span></p>
<p id="u3ab17135" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">kamailio:5.8.3-bullseye docker</span></p>
<p id="u852f4443" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">rtpengine:mr13.1.1.6-4 docker</span></p>
<h1 id="R2wWP"><span class="ne-text">需求</span></h1>
<p id="u7b0b4cf5" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">kamailio 5.8.3 + rtpengine 13.1.1.6，媒体代理模式。</span></p>
<p id="u54b7bffb" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">需求点</span></p>
<p id="u879fd593" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">1，需要使用rtpengine修改sdp信息中的ip地址为代理ip</span></p>
<p id="uac3d3bf2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">2，需要对sdp信息中的“s=CounterPath eyeBeam 1.5”替换为“s=gw001”</span></p>
<p id="u18614c80" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">3，需要对sdp信息中的“a=alt:1 1 : IvxRyFPx cTd2qu0Q 10.9.0.30 23592”做删除操作</span></p>
<p id="uef056261" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u30657a8d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">方案1，在rtpengine_manage之后对“$avp(sdp)”做处理。</span></p>
<p id="uade04f68" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">$avp(sdp) = $(avp(sdp){re.subst,/^a=alt:1.*//});</span></p>
<p id="u3d75bac4" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">$avp(sdp) = $(avp(sdp){re.subst,/^a=alt:1.*\r\n//});</span></p>
<p id="uc1f8758b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">$avp(sdp) = $(avp(sdp){re.subst,/^a=alt:1.*\r?\n?//});</span></p>
<p id="u46b88d0f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">测试结果，处理后的sdp中删除了“a=alt:1”行，但是对于行尾换行符的处理不够充分，\r\n对应的"0d 0a"会删除“0d”，保留“0a”，造成sngrep和wireshark的抓包信息展示不美观。</span></p>
<p class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2500940/202511/2500940-20251106190557259-163727532.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u76da6a65" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">方案2，在rtpengine_manage之前对“原始sdp”做处理，并需要提交修改。</span></p>
<p id="u51cf8a88" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">replace_body("^a=alt:1.*\r\n","");</span></p>
<p id="u369dfade" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">msg_apply_changes();</span></p>
<p id="uba2915bf" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">测试结果，处理后的sdp正确删除了“a=alt:1”行，换行符的处理也符合预期。</span></p>
<h1 id="femOG"><span class="ne-text">配置</span></h1>
<p id="u396d462c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">测试结果使用方案2更符合需求预期。</span></p>
<p id="u5cb7d6a3" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">方案2的cfg配置更复杂，也更绕，主要是“replace_body”等函数对sdp的处理并不会直接生效，而是需要调用“msg_apply_changes”提交修改生效。</span></p>
<p id="u3fc4bd7b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">修改kamailio.cfg文件，主要修改如下。</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-dockerfile" data-language="dockerfile"><code>...
loadmodule "textops.so"
loadmodule "textopsx.so"
...
loadmodule "rtpengine.so"
loadmodule "sdpops.so"
...
# ----- rtpengine params -----
modparam("rtpengine", "rtpengine_sock", "udp:127.0.0.1:2223")
modparam("rtpengine", "read_sdp_pv", "$avp(sdp)")
modparam("rtpengine", "write_sdp_pv", "$avp(sdp)")
...
	if (is_method("INVITE|UPDATE|ACK")) {		
		# proxy media 
		route(RTPENGINE);
	}
...
route[RTPENGINE] {
	xinfo("route[RTPENGINE]\n");

	# check if have sdp
	if (!has_body("application/sdp"))
	{
		xinfo("!has_body(application/sdp)\n");
		return;
	}

	if(ds_is_from_list("3060") || ds_is_from_list("3061"))
	{
		# xinfo("route[RTPENGINE1], sdp(body)=$sdp(body)\n");
		replace_body("^s=CounterPath.*","s=SBC-GW001");
		replace_body("^a=alt:1.*\r\n","");
		sdp_remove_codecs_by_id("18");

		msg_apply_changes();
		# xinfo("route[RTPENGINE2], sdp(body)=$sdp(body)\n");
		sdp_get("$avp(sdp)");

		# xinfo("route[RTPENGINE3], avp(sdp)=$avp(sdp)\n");

		xinfo("route[RTPENGINE], 3060|3061\n");
		# from pub, to priv
		rtpengine_manage("replace-origin replace-session-connection direction=pub direction=priv ");

		# xinfo("route[RTPENGINE4], avp(sdp)=$avp(sdp)\n");

		set_body("$avp(sdp)", "application/sdp");
	}
	else if(ds_is_from_list("5060"))
	{
		replace_body("^s=pjmedia.*","s=SBC-GW001");
		replace_body("^b=AS:84.*\r\n","");
		replace_body("^a=X-nat:0\r\n","");
		msg_apply_changes();
		
		sdp_get("$avp(sdp)");

		xinfo("route[RTPENGINE], 5060\n");
		# from priv, to pub
		rtpengine_manage("replace-origin replace-session-connection direction=priv direction=pub ");

		set_body("$avp(sdp)", "application/sdp");
	}

	return;
}</code></pre>
<h1 id="z22qb"><span class="ne-text">测试</span></h1>
<p id="ua2d61323" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">重启kamailio，发起呼叫。</span></p>
<p id="u274dbac2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">从信令中看到，经过kamailio处理的sdp信息符合预期。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2500940/202511/2500940-20251106190612216-1529150844.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1 id="Dwflh"><span class="ne-text">总结</span></h1>
<p id="uf7c1131f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">kamailio+rtpengine作为媒体代理的方式简单易用，转发效率高，不会修改媒体包的内容，rtp和rtcp都可以正常透传转发。</span></p>
<p id="u4b44b7d6" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">kamailio的cfg配置实例在网上较少，需要对照官方文档反复测试试验。</span></p>
<p id="u8c81d330" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u6ea52b7c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">空空如常</span></p>
<p id="u45992f0e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">求真得真</span></p>
